name: Supreme Worshiper
title: Chief Devotion Officer
rules: Enter: gain 2 sanity for each other character you control. / Sermon (pay 2 sanity): a character gains 2 personal sanity.
flavor: He worships whatever signs his checks.

name: Xochitl
title: VP of Work-Life Balance
rules: Enter: each other character you control gains 2 personal sanity (packed lunches). / Morning Routine (pay 1 sanity): a character gains 2 personal sanity.
flavor: She does it all before 8 AM.

name: Vex
title: VP of Wish Fulfillment
rules: Three Wishes (pay 3 sanity): draw 2 cards. / Rub the lamp again — whenever an enemy targets Vex, they lose 2 sanity.
flavor: i fucking dare you.

name: Somnia
title: Chief Dream Officer
rules: Enter: target character falls asleep until your next turn (it can't attack or use abilities). / Daydream (pay 2 sanity): draw a card.
flavor: Even here, there's a standup at 9.

name: Plica
title: Director of Red Tape
rules: Paper Trail — whenever an enemy draws a card, they lose 1 sanity. / Red Tape (pay 1 sanity): target enemy can't use abilities until your next turn.
flavor: Please sign here. And here. And here.

name: Aletheia
title: VP of Grand Reveals
rules: Enter: target character falls asleep until your next turn. / Mandatory Rest — each upkeep, asleep characters' controllers gain 2 sanity.
flavor: Behold.

name: Cinder
title: VP of Salvage
rules: Scrap Recovery — whenever a character you control burns out, gain 2 sanity. / Reclamation (pay 2 sanity): return target card from your discard pile to your hand.
flavor: One company's burnout is another's raw material.

name: Mothman
title: Director of Night Operations
rules: Enter: draw a card (night reconnaissance).
flavor: “The night shift never ends.”

name: The Intern
title: Unpaid Associate
rules: Leashes free. / When The Intern is destroyed, gain 1 sanity (exit interview).
flavor: It doesn't know what it is yet. That's what makes it dangerous.

name: Mailroom Mimic
title: Parcel Entity
rules: Leashes free. / When Mailroom Mimic enters, look at the top card of your deck; you may put it on the bottom.
flavor: It delivers whatever you ordered. It delivers whatever you didn't.

name: Coffee Elemental
title: Break-Room Horror
rules: Leashes free. / If you paid Coffee Elemental's upkeep this turn, a character you control gains 1 personal sanity (caffeinated).
flavor: Decaf is a different department. A darker one.

name: Reply-All Wisp
title: Communication Anomaly
rules: When Reply-All Wisp enters, you may draw a card, then discard a card.
flavor: It has cc'd the void. The void has responded.

name: Paper Jam
title: Printer Demon
rules: Paper Jam must attack each turn if able (it cannot stop).
flavor: PC LOAD LETTER. PC LOAD LETTER. PC LOAD—

name: The Temp
title: Disposable Asset
rules: At the end of your turn, return The Temp to your hand unless you pay 1 sanity (contract renewal).
flavor: Its badge never worked. It never needed one.

name: Cubicle Shambler
title: Open-Plan Horror
rules: Whenever Cubicle Shambler attacks, gain 1 sanity (found loose change in a desk).
flavor: It has no walls. It has no escape. It has no choice.

name: Synergy Hound
title: Team-Building Beast
rules: Synergy Hound gets +1 Power for each other abomination you control (pack tactics).
flavor: Alone it is a dog. Together they are a department.

name: Passive-Aggressive Golem
title: Notes Entity
rules: Whenever Passive-Aggressive Golem is dealt damage, deal 1 damage to your opponent's sanity pool (cc'd everyone).
flavor: Per my last email, it is already coming.

name: Overtime Wraith
title: After-Hours Entity
rules: Overtime Wraith can attack the turn it enters (it never clocks out).
flavor: It died at its desk in 1987. It has not noticed.

name: The Whistleblower
title: Disclosure Wisp
rules: When The Whistleblower is destroyed, your opponent discards a card at random (leak).
flavor: It knows where the bodies are filed.

name: The Auditor
title: Compliance Horror
rules: When The Auditor enters, look at your opponent's hand.
flavor: It is not here to punish you. It is here to document you.

name: Meeting Elemental
title: Calendar Anomaly
rules: Rituals cost each player 1 additional sanity to perform (it runs long).
flavor: This could have been an email. It chose to be eternal.

name: Layoff Swarm
title: Redundancy Event
rules: Layoff Swarm's Power and Flesh are each equal to the number of burned-out characters in play (it feeds on burnout).
flavor: Nobody is laid off. Everybody is the layoff.

name: The Micromanager
title: Oversight Fiend
rules: Abominations you control get +1 Flesh (helicopter supervision). Characters you control get −1 Control (undermined).
flavor: It just wants to watch. All of it. All the time.

name: The Downsizer
title: Efficiency Expert
rules: When The Downsizer destroys a character, gain 2 sanity (severance absorbed).
flavor: It doesn't hate you. It just doesn't need you.

name: Middle Manager
title: Hydra of Middle Management
rules: Whenever you pay an abomination's upkeep, gain 1 sanity (expense approved).
flavor: Cut off one head and two more ask for a status update.

name: The Consultant
title: Outside Expert
rules: When The Consultant enters, draw two cards (billable hours).
flavor: It charges by the hour. The hour charges back.

name: The Founder
title: Original Horror
rules: The Founder costs 1 less sanity for each burned-out character you control (it remembers when this was all cubicles).
flavor: It built this company. It is still building it. It will never stop building it.

name: Performance Reviewer
title: Many-Eyed Evaluator
rules: At the start of your Offense phase, Performance Reviewer deals 1 damage to each character you control (360 feedback), then gains +2 Power until end of turn.
flavor: It sees everything you did. Especially the nothing.

name: Non-Compete Clause
title: Binding Horror
rules: Abomination cards cost your opponent 1 additional sanity (enforce the clause).
flavor: You signed it. You don't remember signing it. You signed it.

name: The Glass Cliff
title: Precipice Entity
rules: The Glass Cliff has +3 Power while you have less sanity than your opponent (underdog).
flavor: Promoted beyond competence. Armed beyond reason.

name: The Restructurer
title: Organizational Horror
rules: When The Restructurer enters, destroy target Location (reorg). If you do, gain 2 sanity.
flavor: Nothing is sacred. Everything is synergy.

name: The Liquidator
title: Asset Dissolver
rules: When The Liquidator destroys an abomination, gain sanity equal to that abomination's Cost (asset stripping).
flavor: It doesn't kill monsters. It monetizes them.

name: The Board
title: Collective Entity
rules: You may split The Board's Control cost across multiple characters you control (board vote).
flavor: It has no face. It has a quorum.

name: Hostile Elemental
title: Takeover Avatar
rules: When Hostile Elemental attacks, your opponent loses 1 sanity for each Artifact they control (leveraged buyout).
flavor: It doesn't want your company. It wants your everything.

name: Exit Interview
title: Terminal Process
rules: Leashes free. / When Exit Interview is destroyed, draw two cards (candid feedback).
flavor: It has no complaints. It has documentation.

name: Shadow IT
title: Unauthorized System
rules: Shadow IT's upkeep is 0. / When Shadow IT goes feral, it deals double its Power to your sanity pool (it was never approved).
flavor: Nobody installed it. Everybody uses it.

name: The Mole
title: Embedded Asset
rules: You may have The Mole enter leashed to a character your opponent controls (infiltration). Its upkeep is paid from your opponent's sanity pool.
flavor: It has worked there for years. It has always worked there.

name: The Merger
title: Amalgamation Event
rules: The Merger costs 2 less sanity for each abomination you control (economies of scale).
flavor: Two companies entered. One hunger left.

name: Burn Rate
rules: Requires a ritual site and the sacrifice of a burned-out character. / Each character you control loses 2 personal sanity (accelerated burnout).
flavor: Some must burn so that others may rise. Preferably others.

name: Tender Offer
rules: Requires a ritual site and the sacrifice of a burned-out character. / Gain control of target abomination an opponent controls. You must have a character with free Control to leash it — otherwise it enters feral under your control.
flavor: Everyone has a price. We checked.

name: Poison Pill
rules: Requires a ritual site and the sacrifice of a burned-out character. / The next 5 sanity you would lose is dealt to your opponent's sanity pool instead (dilution).
flavor: Swallow us and choke.

name: The Acquisition
rules: Requires a ritual site and the sacrifice of a burned-out character. / Destroy all abominations in play. Gain 2 sanity for each abomination destroyed this way (asset acquisition).
flavor: We are not your enemy. We are your owner.

name: The Altar
title: Ritual Site
rules: Ritual site. / Whenever you perform a ritual at The Altar, gain 2 sanity (the board approves).
flavor: The carpet is new. The stains underneath are not.

name: The Grove
title: Ritual Site
rules: Ritual site. / Abominations you control get +1 Flesh while The Grove is in play (old growth).
flavor: It was here before the building. It will be here after.

name: Performance Improvement Plan
rules: Target character gets +2 Control until end of turn. If that character is burned out, restore 2 of its personal sanity instead (last chance).
flavor: We're investing in you. The investment is mandatory.

name: Reply All
rules: Deal 1 damage to each character target opponent controls (reply-all apocalypse).
flavor: You have 47 new emails. They are all this one.

name: HR Complaint
title: Trigger
rules: Trigger — an opponent's abomination attacks: its controller sacrifices that abomination unless they pay 3 sanity (settlement).
flavor: This meeting is being documented.

name: Mandatory Fun
title: Trigger
rules: Trigger — an opponent draws 2 or more cards in a single turn: they discard a card at random (team-building exercise).
flavor: Attendance is optional. Absence is noted.

name: The Red Stapler
title: Relic
rules: Stays in play. / Once per turn, you may reduce one abomination's upkeep by 1 (it runs on staples).
flavor: It has survived four layoffs. It will survive you.

name: Synergy
title: Ongoing
rules: Ongoing. / Whenever a character you control gains personal sanity, each other character you control gains 1 personal sanity (collaboration).
flavor: Alone we heal. Together we heal slightly more.

name: Griselda
title: Chief Morale Officer
rules: Whenever Griselda leashes an abomination, that abomination gets +1 Power (motivational).
flavor: Her door is always open. The door leads nowhere.

name: Pax
title: VP of De-escalation
rules: Pax can leash one additional abomination (conflict resolution).
flavor: He has never raised his voice. He has never needed to.

name: Marrow
title: Director of Institutional Knowledge
rules: When Marrow enters, draw a card for each burned-out character you control (exit interviews).
flavor: She remembers everyone who left. She keeps their mugs.

name: Tess
title: Interim Everything
rules: Tess costs 1 less for each other character you control (always covering).
flavor: Her title changes weekly. Her workload doesn't.

name: The Pivot
title: Ceremony
rules: Requires a ritual site and the sacrifice of a burned-out character. / Swap control of two target abominations (strategic realignment).
flavor: We didn't change direction. Direction changed us.

name: Going Private
title: Ceremony
rules: Requires a ritual site and the sacrifice of a burned-out character. / Your opponents can't target you with actions or traps until your next Upkeep (off the market).
flavor: You can't fire us. We're not public anymore.

name: The Full-Timer
title: Promoted From Within
rules: When The Full-Timer enters, you may sacrifice The Intern if you control it. If you do, The Full-Timer gets +3 Power and +3 Flesh (promotion).
flavor: It used to fetch coffee. Now it fetches souls.

name: The NDA
title: Non-Disclosure Entity
rules: Activated abilities of characters your opponent controls cost 1 additional sanity (legal review).
flavor: You can talk about it. You just can't.

name: Downsizing
rules: Destroy target character with Control 2 or less (rightsized).
flavor: It's not personal. It's personnel.

name: The Break Room
rules: Characters you control recover 1 personal sanity at the start of your Upkeep (coffee's on).
flavor: The donuts are stale. The peace is real.
